verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

verses.ar: «يَا ٱبْنَ آدَمَ، ٱجْعَلْ وَجْهَكَ نَحْوَ جَبَلِ سَعِيرَ وَتَنَبَّأْ عَلَيْهِ،
verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.web: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.he: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ עַל־הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֑יר וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽיו׃

verses.ar: وَقُلْ لَهُ: هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: هَأَنَذَا عَلَيْكَ يَا جَبَلَ سَعِيرَ، وَأَمُدُّ يَدِي عَلَيْكَ وَأَجْعَلُكَ خَرَابًا مُقْفِرًا.
verses.kjv: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I [am] against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
verses.web: and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
verses.he: וְאָמַ֣רְתָּ לֹּ֗ו כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַר־שֵׂעִ֑יר וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ שְׁמָמָ֥ה וּמְשַׁמָּֽה׃

verses.ar: أَجْعَلُ مُدُنَكَ خَرِبَةً، وَتَكُونُ أَنْتَ مُقْفِرًا، وَتَعْلَمُ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
verses.he: עָרֶ֙יךָ֙ חָרְבָּ֣ה אָשִׂ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ كَانَتْ لَكَ بُغْضَةٌ أَبَدِيَّةٌ، وَدَفَعْتَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى يَدِ ٱلسَّيْفِ فِي وَقْتِ مُصِيبَتِهِمْ، وَقْتِ إِثْمِ ٱلنِّهَايَةِ.
verses.kjv: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed [the blood of] the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time [that their] iniquity [had] an end:
verses.web: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
verses.he: יַ֗עַן הֱיֹ֤ות לְךָ֙ אֵיבַ֣ת עֹולָ֔ם וַתַּגֵּ֥ר אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־יְדֵי־חָ֑רֶב בְּעֵ֣ת אֵידָ֔ם בְּעֵ֖ת עֲוֹ֥ן קֵֽץ׃

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ حَيٌّ أَنَا، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ، إِنِّي أُهَيِّئُكَ لِلدَّمِ، وَٱلدَّمُ يَتْبَعُكَ. إِذْ لَمْ تَكْرَهِ ٱلدَّمَ فَٱلدَّمُ يَتْبَعُكَ.
verses.kjv: Therefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
verses.web: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.
verses.he: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כִּֽי־לְדָ֥ם אֶעֶשְׂךָ֖ וְדָ֣ם יִרְדֲּפֶ֑ךָ אִם־לֹ֥א דָ֛ם שָׂנֵ֖אתָ וְדָ֥ם יִרְדֲּפֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: فَأَجْعَلُ جَبَلَ سَعِيرَ خَرَابًا وَمُقْفِرًا، وَأَسْتَأْصِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلذَّاهِبَ وَٱلْآئِبَ.
verses.kjv: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.
verses.web: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
verses.he: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר לְשִֽׁמְמָ֖ה וּשְׁמָמָ֑ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֹבֵ֥ר וָשָֽׁב׃

verses.ar: وَأَمْلَأُ جِبَالَهُ مِنْ قَتْلَاهُ. تِلَالُكَ وَأَوْدِيَتُكَ وَجَمِيعُ أَنْهَارِكَ يَسْقُطُونَ فِيهَا قَتْلَى بِٱلسَّيْفِ.
verses.kjv: And I will fill his mountains with his slain [men:] in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.web: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
verses.he: וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י אֶת־הָרָ֖יו חֲלָלָ֑יו גִּבְעֹותֶ֤יךָ וְגֵאֹותֶ֙יךָ֙ וְכָל־אֲפִיקֶ֔יךָ חַלְלֵי־חֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَأُصَيِّرُكَ خِرَبًا أَبَدِيَّةً، وَمُدُنُكَ لَنْ تَعُودَ، فَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
verses.he: שִֽׁמְמֹ֤ות עֹולָם֙ אֶתֶּנְךָ֔ וְעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א *תֵישַׁבְנָה (תָשֹׁ֑בְנָה) וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ قُلْتَ: إِنَّ هَاتَيْنِ ٱلْأُمَّتَيْنِ، وَهَاتَيْنِ ٱلْأَرْضَيْنِ تَكُونَانِ لِي فَنَمْتَلِكُهُمَا وَٱلرَّبُّ كَانَ هُنَاكَ،
verses.kjv: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:
verses.web: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although Yahweh was there,
verses.he: יַ֣עַן אֲ֠מָרְךָ אֶת־שְׁנֵ֨י הַגֹּויִ֜ם וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֧י הָאֲרָצֹ֛ות לִ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ינָה וִֽירַשְׁנ֑וּהָ וַֽיהוָ֖ה שָׁ֥ם הָיָֽה׃

verses.ar: فَلِذَلِكَ حَيٌّ أَنَا، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ، لِأَفْعَلَنَّ كَغَضَبِكَ وَكَحَسَدِكَ ٱللَّذَيْنِ عَامَلْتَ بِهِمَا مِنْ بُغْضَتِكَ لَهُمْ، وَأُعَرِّفُ بِنَفْسِي بَيْنَهُمْ عِنْدَمَا أَحْكُمُ عَلَيْكَ،
verses.kjv: Therefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
verses.web: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
verses.he: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי כְּאַפְּךָ֙ וּכְקִנְאָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָה מִשִּׂנְאָתֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם וְנֹודַ֥עְתִּי בָ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶשְׁפְּטֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: فَتَعْلَمُ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ، قَدْ سَمِعْتُ كُلَّ إِهَانَتِكَ ٱلَّتِي تَكَلَّمْتَ بِهَا عَلَى جِبَالِ إِسْرَائِيلَ قَائِلًا: قَدْ خَرِبَتْ. قَدْ أُعْطِينَاهَا مَأْكَلًا.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD, [and that] I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
verses.web: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’
verses.he: וְֽיָדַעְתָּ֮ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי ׀ אֶת־כָּל־נָאָֽצֹותֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛רְתָּ עַל־הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֣ר ׀ *שָׁמֵמָה (שָׁמֵ֑מוּ) לָ֥נוּ נִתְּנ֖וּ לְאָכְלָֽה׃

verses.ar: قَدْ تَعَظَّمْتُمْ عَلَيَّ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ وَكَثَّرْتُمْ كَلَامَكُمْ عَلَيَّ. أَنَا سَمِعْتُ.
verses.kjv: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard [them].
verses.web: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”
verses.he: וַתַּגְדִּ֤ילוּ עָלַי֙ בְּפִיכֶ֔ם וְהַעְתַּרְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃ ס

verses.ar: هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: عِنْدَ فَرَحِ كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَجْعَلُكَ مُقْفِرًا.
verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
verses.web: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
verses.he: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּשְׂמֹ֙חַ֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֖ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: كَمَا فَرِحْتَ عَلَى مِيرَاثِ بَيْتِ إِسْرَائِيلَ لِأَنَّهُ خَرِبَ، كَذَلِكَ أَفْعَلُ بِكَ. تَكُونُ خَرَابًا يَا جَبَلَ سَعِيرَ أَنْتَ وَكُلُّ أَدُومَ بِأَجْمَعِهَا، فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, [even] all of it: and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
verses.he: כְּשִׂמְחָ֨תְךָ֜ לְנַחְלַ֧ת בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמֵ֖מָה כֵּ֣ן אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּ֑ךְ שְׁמָמָ֨ה תִֽהְיֶ֤ה הַר־שֵׂעִיר֙ וְכָל־אֱדֹ֣ום כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ פ
